record.paper_title: Some open problems on Banach spaces
record.original_question: For a real Banach lattice X and a real number lambda >= 1, suppose X is lambda-injective, meaning that whenever Y is a Banach lattice, Y0 is a closed sublattice of Y, and T0:Y0 -> X is a positive operator, there is a positive extension T:Y -> X with ||T|| <= lambda ||T0||. Must every lambda-injective Banach lattice be order-isomorphic to a 1-injective Banach lattice?

evidence.quote: A real Banach lattice X is said to be λ-injective, if for every Banach lattice Y , closed sublattice Y0 ⊂ Y , and positive operator T0 : Y0 → X there exists a positive extension T : Y → X with kTk ≤ λkT0k.
Problem 4.2. Is every λ-injective Banach lattice order isomorphic to 1-injective Banach lattice?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $X$ be a real Banach lattice and let $\lambda \geq 1$. Say that $X$ is $\lambda$-injective if, for every real Banach lattice $Y$, every closed vector sublattice $Y_0 \subseteq Y$, and every positive linear operator $T_0 : Y_0 \to X$, there exists a positive linear extension $T : Y \to X$ (i.e. $T|_{Y_0} = T_0$) with $\|T\| \leq \lambda \|T_0\|$. Determine whether the following statement holds: every $\lambda$-injective Banach lattice (for some $\lambda \geq 1$) is order isomorphic to a $1$-injective Banach lattice.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published resolution of the question whether every $\lambda$-injective Banach lattice is order isomorphic to a $1$-injective Banach lattice. Related work on injective Banach lattices (e.g. characterizations via extremally disconnected compact spaces and AL-/AM-structure, and recent work on injective objects in categories of Banach lattices with upper $p$-estimates) appears, but no result directly settling this specific isomorphic-vs-isometric injectivity question was found.

status_evidence.title: Geometric Characterization of Injective Banach Lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of injective Banach lattices via geometric and Boolean-valued methods.
status_evidence.claim: Research on injective Banach lattices continues, but the specific isomorphic question is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattices with upper p-estimates: free and injective objects
status_evidence.snippet: Studies injective objects in subcategories of Banach lattices.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work explores injectivity in Banach lattices but does not resolve whether $\lambda$-injective implies order isomorphic to $1$-injective.
